description: Free. Use when the user needs an official euro exchange rate or a conversion for an invoice, contract or report: ECB euro reference rates (about 30 currencies), today or any working day in the last 90 days, with cross rates. Input: base (default EUR), symbols (e.g. USD,GBP), optional date YYYY-MM-DD and amount.
